name: Don't press the KEY CAP
desc:
What happens when you press the KeyCap? 👀
There's only one way to find out... Press it! 💥

🎮 Play crazy minigames, survive & have fun with friends!
🛠️ Buy awesome gear to help you survive and win minigames!
✋ Get Pushes and knock other players out of your way!
🆕 NEW MINIGAMES EVERY DAY — at least 1 new minigame added daily!
💡 Have a minigame idea? Send it through Feedback and it might be the next minigame added!

👑 VIP SUBSCRIPTION 👑
Become a VIP and unlock exclusive rewards:
⭐ Exclusive VIP Name Tag & Chat Tag
🪙 2x Coins
🪄 Exclusive Golden Flying Carpet
🎡 Exclusive VIP Lucky Wheel with different rewards

🎁 Join our group for special perks & benefits!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/589267769

Every KeyCap can lead to a different challenge. You never know what's coming next! 👀

Invite your friends, grab your gear and see how many minigames you can survive! 🏆

👍 Like & Favorite the game for more updates!
⭐ Follow the game so you don't miss new minigames!

llm.loop: press a mysterious keycap -> a random minigame starts -> survive it with friends using gear and pushes -> earn coins -> spin the lucky wheel
llm.objectives: survive as many minigames as possible
llm.instructions: press the keycap, play minigames, buy gear, push others; new minigame daily
unique: at least one new minigame daily, some from player suggestions; Roblox subscription VIP
